# Reliability release drill

A release owner must decide whether a rollback restored the service. Reconcile technical probes, the critical business flow and records written after release.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
[
  {
    "version": "v1",
    "rate": 0.005,
    "recovered": true,
    "rollbackAllowed": true
  },
  {
    "version": "v2",
    "rate": 0.08,
    "recovered": false,
    "rollbackAllowed": true
  },
  {
    "version": "rollback",
    "rate": 0.004285714285714286,
    "recovered": false,
    "rollbackAllowed": false
  }
]
```

## Failure prevented
A normal error rate with a failed business probe is not recovery.

## Decision and limits
Accept only the specified result set. Escalate a missing identity, permission, business probe or required not-run item. This is an original synthetic teaching reference, not evidence of learner execution or real employment.
